item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00092","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C05","C03","C24"],"selected_candidate_label":"C05","confidence":0.98,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C05 is a nearly contemporaneous order with the same distinctive drafting purpose: designating an ordered succession of departmental officers to perform a Secretary's duties when the Secretary and Under Secretary are unavailable. The child and C05 titles are closely parallel, differing principally in the department, and C05 supplies concrete succession machinery readily adaptable from Agriculture to Labor. C03 concerns designation of officials but not acting-secretary succession, while C24 merely delegates functions to a department head.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"designation certain officers act secretary labor","parent_excerpt":"designation certain officers act secrtary agriculture","explanation":"The unusually close parallel titles identify the same type of order, adapted from one department to another."},{"child_excerpt":"act secretary labor","parent_excerpt":"In case of the absence, sickness, resignation, or death of both the Secretary of Agriculture and the Under Secretary of Agriculture, the officer whose name is highest on the following list and who is not absent or under disability to discharge the duties of the office of the Secretary of Agriculture shall perform the duties of that office","explanation":"C05 provides the material operative framework for an acting-secretary succession order: triggering vacancies or disabilities, a ranked list, and authority for the highest available officer to perform the Secretary's duties."}]}
